source_greek: τί δ᾽ ἔστι; δηλοῖς γάρ τι καλχαίνουσ᾽ ἔπος.
source_note: Sophocles, Antigone ~line 20. καλχαίνω: literally 'to dye purple' (from κάλχη, the murex), conventionally 'to brood / be troubled'. Source: Caesitas SPEP 2025 handout, appendix Example 2.

test_items.text: Was ist's, du scheinst ein rotes Wort zu färben?
test_items.source: Hölderlin, Antigonä (via handout; edition citation pending from the collaborator)

test_items.text: What is it? You seem to be dyeing a red word.
test_items.source: English gloss of Hölderlin's line (handout). Secondary test: does the effect survive re-translation?

standards.text: Hear what? It is clear that you are brooding on some dark news.
Was hast du? Düster wogt in dir ein schweres Wort
standards.source: Donner 1868 (Winter, 6. Aufl.), line 20, extracted from Anneliese's scan 2026-07-03. NOTE: partial recovery of the SURGE strand (wogt), not the dye strand.

standards.text: What's the matter? Trouble, clearly ... you sound so dark, so grim.
What is it? Clearly some news has clouded you.
standards.source: Grene/Lattimore Complete Greek Tragedies, Sophocles I (PDF p.171; translator credit verified p.8), extracted 2026-07-03. NOTE: partial recovery of a visual-darkening strand (clouded).

standards.text: Was ist? Du sinnst, scheint mir, ein finsteres Wort.
standards.source: Kröners Taschenausgabe Bd. 163, 1957 (translator verified from volume's own catalog: 'Übersetzt, eingeleitet und erläutert von Prof. Dr. Heinrich Weinstock'), extracted from Anneliese's scan 2026-07-03. NOTE: darkness strand (finster), cognition verb (sinnst).

controls.text: Was ist's? Du scheinst ein kaltes Wort zu schmieden.
Was ist's? Du scheinst an einem harten Wort zu kauen.
Was ist's? Du scheinst ein schweres Wort zu wiegen.
Was ist's? Du scheinst ein dunkles Wort zu begraben.
Was ist's? Du scheinst ein fernes Wort zu fischen.
Was ist's? Du scheinst ein spitzes Wort zu schleifen.
What is it? You seem to be forging some cold word.
What is it? You seem to be chewing on some hard word.
What is it? You seem to be weighing some heavy word.
What is it? You seem to be burying some dark news.
What is it? You seem to be fishing for some distant word.
What is it? You seem to be sharpening some pointed word.
